legend: Single scattered large neoplastic cells with prominent nucleoli and partly with multilobated nuclear morphology are seen in a dense, non-neoplastic, lymphohistiocytic background (<<29218>>). Pink-appearing histiocytes mask the few pleomorphic tumour cells present (<<29711>>). Higher magnification shows pleomorphic tumour cells with atypical, partly multilobated nuclei (<<29224>>). There are abundant histiocytes, in this case with few T lymphocytes and neoplastic cells (<<29712>>).
CD20 immunostaining highlights single scattered large B cells. Small reactive B cells are virtually absent from the microenvironment.

CD20 immunostaining shows pleomorphic neoplastic cells with a virtual absence of small B cells (<<29221>>). CD3 immunostaining highlights abundant small reactive T cells in the microenvironment (<<31895>>). There are abundant CD163-positive macrophages (<<29220>>). Histiocytes express nuclear and cytoplasmic MT2A, indicating the metal-binding properties of these particular histiocytes (<<31386>>).
